description: This script defines a function 'preinit_set_mac_address' that sets MAC addresses on various network interfaces depending on the device model, identified by 'board_name'. It utilizes different external files and commands to retrieve MAC addresses and applies them to network devices during pre-initialization.

methods.name: preinit_set_mac_address
methods.description: Sets MAC addresses for network interfaces based on device model, using different retrieval methods depending on the model.
